name: Quadrifoil
description: Four discs set on the quarters, overlapping just enough to read as one shape.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 4%; right: 4%; top: 26%; bottom: 26%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); border-radius: 50%; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 26%; right: 26%; top: 4%; bottom: 4%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); border-radius: 50%; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
